request.deadline: 2026-2027 delivery period; exact milestone dates not stated in document
deliverables: Peras v1 mainnet readiness including production cryptography, KillSwitch, hard-fork readiness, support and maintenance
History Expiry for partial-history nodes intended to reduce SPO storage costs
Conformance Testing framework extended for Peras and Leios
Merged code, reproducible releases, runbooks, benchmarks, and governance-action packages where governance activation is required
Public demos at least every two months, status updates, and community coordination channels
request.recipient: Tweag by Modus Create, administered by Intersect/Cardano Development Holdings via treasury reserve and project-specific smart contracts
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Tweag by Modus Create's delivery of three Cardano core infrastructure work packages over 2026-2027.

claims.claim: The proposal requests ₳18,263,496.00, described as USD $4,565,874.00, for three core infrastructure work packages delivered over 2026-2027.
The work packages are Peras v1, History Expiry, and Conformance Testing for Peras and Leios, and the proposer says they are interdependent parts of a single delivery pipeline.
The proposer states Peras would improve finality to about 2 minutes compared with about 12 minutes today.
The proposer states Leios-driven throughput could cause SPO disk usage to surge to about 1 GB per hour at 100-1000 TPS unless History Expiry reduces full-history storage requirements.
The budget is said to be based on an average $176 per hour market rate for senior Cardano infrastructure engineers and a conservative ADA/USD conversion rate of 0.25 based on a 5-year average.

The proposal says milestones, acceptance criteria, payment amounts, and delivery dates will be agreed later between Tweag and Intersect in an off-chain legal contract and made public through budget-management metadata.
The proposer says technical deliverables will undergo mandatory IOG code review and independent validation by No Witness Labs as a third-party assessor.

The proposal states Intersect will administer funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts, with named 2025 oversight committee entities and specified multisignature authorization thresholds.
The proposer states all undisbursed funds at the end of the delivery period, and proportional unspent funds from partial delivery or scope reduction, will be returned to the Cardano Treasury.
The proposal states the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.

summary: The document requests ₳18.263496M for Tweag-managed Cardano core infrastructure work administered by Intersect, with high materiality claims around Peras deployment, History Expiry, conformance testing, milestone-based contracting, oversight, and NCL compliance.
